# Kidz Korner Milton

## About

Kidz Korner is a family-owned and operated daycare and indoor playground located in Milton, Ontario. Established over 30 years ago, Kidz Korner provides childcare and children's programs in a family-oriented environment.

Website: https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/
Location: 150 Nipissing Rd Units #10 & 11, Milton, Ontario L9T 5B3

## Services

- [Daycare](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/daycare): Childcare programs for toddlers, preschool-aged children, and school-aged children.
- [Toddler Daycare](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/daycare/toddler): Daycare program designed for toddlers in a supportive and engaging environment.
- [Preschool Daycare](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/daycare/preschool): Preschool childcare program focused on early learning, development, and social interaction.
- [Before & After School Care](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/daycare/before-after-school): Before-school and after-school care for school-aged children.
- [Camps](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/camp): Children's camp programs offered during school breaks.
- [Summer Camp](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/camp/summer): Summer camp programming for school-aged children during the summer break.
- [March Break Camp](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/camp/march-break): Camp programming during the March Break.
- [Winter Break Camp](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/camp/winter-break): Camp programming during the winter school break.
- [PA Day Camp](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/camp/pa-day): Camp programming available on select PA Days.
- [Indoor Playground](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/indoor-playground): Indoor children's play facility available for play and private events.
- [Birthday Parties](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/birthday-parties): Private children's birthday parties and party packages.
- [Workshops](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/workshops): Children's workshops and activities including arts, cooking, baking, learning, and parent-and-child activities.
- [About Kidz Korner](https://www.kidzkornermilton.com/about): Information about Kidz Korner and its family-operated facility.

## Location

- Main Center: 150 Nipissing Rd Units #10 & 11, Milton, ON L9T 5B3
- Approximately 2 km from Milton GO Station.
- Conveniently located for families travelling through Milton and for parents commuting toward the Milton GO Station or Highway 401.

- Hours: Monday - Friday: 9:00am - 6:00pm
- Weekends: Open for private parties by appointment.

## Service Area

Kidz Korner primarily serves families in Milton and surrounding communities, including Halton Hills, Meadowvale, and Hornby.

## Key Facts

- Family-owned and operated
- 30+ years in business
- Located in Milton, Ontario
- Daycare and children's programs
- Indoor playground
- Birthday parties
- Children's camps
- Children's workshops
- Specialized support for children with special needs
- Montessori-quality childcare
- In-house cook and seasonal meal program

## What Makes Us Different

Kidz Korner is a family-operated childcare and children's activity center that emphasizes personalized care and individual attention.

The facility includes an in-house cook who prepares a rotating seasonal menu. Educational activities and workshops are incorporated into children's programs, providing opportunities for learning, creativity, and development alongside childcare.

Kidz Korner also provides specialized support for children with special needs and works with families to create an inclusive and supportive environment.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the pricing for full-time child care?**

Pricing varies depending on the child's age and program requirements. Families should contact Kidz Korner directly for current pricing and availability.

**Do you provide meals for the children?**

Yes. Kidz Korner has an in-house cook who prepares meals using a rotating seasonal menu.

**Can you accommodate children with special needs?**

Yes. Kidz Korner provides specialized support for children with special needs and works with families to provide an inclusive and supportive environment.

**Are weekend parties private?**

Yes. Weekend bookings are reserved for private parties by appointment.

**What ages do you accept for camps and school programs?**

Kidz Korner provides programs for toddlers through school-aged children, including toddler and preschool daycare, before-and-after school care, PA Day camps, and seasonal camps.

**How do you handle transitions for new children starting daycare?**

Kidz Korner offers an Orientation Week during which children can attend for shorter periods while becoming familiar with their teachers, classmates, and environment. Families and staff work together to make the transition into daycare as comfortable as possible.
